body:
Depends on "Strategy Features tab: read-only list".

- Up and down buttons inside a group. Each PATCHes `rank` to the midpoint between the neighbours, or to the neighbour's rank ∓ 1 at either end. One PATCH per move.
- Delete asks for confirmation inside the page: "Delete *title*? Its N tasks lose their link to it; the tasks stay." Then it sends `DELETE /features/{id}`. The `{removedFeature}` and `{task}` events update the page.
- Tests: the midpoint at the first, middle and last positions, the delete text naming the count, and a move-and-delete step in the JS flow. Update the README.

Pieces 2–4 of the Features tab all edit `features.gleam` and `update`, so run them one after another rather than in parallel.
title: Strategy Features tab: reorder and delete
